shared_elements: carved figural subject rendered in stone relief/sculpture
justification: The only real correspondence is that each contains a head with rendered features — A a frontal, heavily schematic face with lozenge eyes, ridge nose and slit mouth filling the whole surface, B a small profile head belonging to a recumbent creature within a larger low-relief scene of limbs and textured plumage/mane. The conventions differ completely: A is a frontal, three-dimensional, blocky abstraction with no scene context, while B is a lateral narrative composition with patterned infill and overlapping bodies, so nothing suggests a shared iconographic scheme.
